feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Ukrainian GCSE to be offered to British students
articles.summary: Students in England, Wales and Northern Ireland will be able to take a Ukrainian GCSE from 2028 as part of government plans.

articles.title: Parliament risks 'catastrophic event' without urgent renovation
articles.summary: The Palace of Westminster is at risk of a "catastrophic event" if delays to a renovation initiative are not resolved, a group of MPs have warned.

articles.title: Third teen arrested on suspicion of attempted murder over stabbing at Halloween party
articles.summary: A third boy has been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after five teenagers were seriously injured when they were allegedly stabbed at a party on Halloween.

articles.title: MPs urge online retailers to stop selling AI toys over child harm fears
articles.summary: AI toys with built-in chatbots could expose children to psychological harms and inappropriate material, according to MPs and peers who are urging Amazon and eBay to stop selling them.

articles.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor ordered to give evidence at businessman's fraud trial, Sky News understands
articles.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor has been served a summons compelling him to give evidence at a Turkish businessman's fraud trial, Sky News understands.

articles.title: Reform councillor charged with 35 offences including 12 counts of rape
articles.summary: A Reform UK councillor says he is "shocked and dismayed" after being charged with 35 offences, including 12 counts of rape.

articles.title: Train knifeman appeared to believe 17-year-old victim was the devil, court hears
articles.summary: A man who stabbed a teenager on a train in London appeared to believe the boy was the devil, a court has heard.

articles.title: Bomb threats reported on multiple flights, including two from UK airports
articles.summary: At least seven flights, including two from the UK, have been affected by bomb threats, which caused unplanned landings and temporary airport closures.

articles.title: Boy, 14, arrested after reports of Bradley Lowery taunt at football match
articles.summary: A 14-year-old boy has been arrested after reports that a Coventry fan appeared to taunt Sunderland supporters about Bradley Lowery.

articles.title: Cyber attacks affect UK meat processing industry, top security official says
articles.summary: Cyber attacks have affected the UK meat processing industry, a top security official has said in the wake of hacks that hit supermarkets across Europe.
